patterns.name: Validated form workflow
patterns.summary: Compose a readable EditForm from field primitives, responsive geometry, validation feedback, and an explicit action boundary.
patterns.intent: Use this pattern when a page collects related values that must remain understandable before, during, and after validation.

ingredients.role: Names the task and groups its supporting guidance.
Defines responsive field geometry without owning business fields.
Lets an individual control opt into column span and placement.
Provides the labelled text-input contract.
Provides a typed choice contract.
Collects model-level errors when a summary is useful.
Separates commit and cancel actions from the data fields.
Expresses submit priority and secondary actions.

compositionSteps.title: Start with the model boundary
compositionSteps.detail: Create one EditContext or model for the task and keep validation rules beside that model.

compositionSteps.title: Group before arranging
compositionSteps.detail: Use FormSection to explain the task, then FormGrid and FormField to describe geometry.

compositionSteps.title: Bind semantic controls
compositionSteps.detail: Choose inputs by value type and always provide a visible label and useful description.

compositionSteps.title: Close with an action boundary
compositionSteps.detail: Place validation feedback before FormActions so the submit path is predictable in reading and focus order.

libraryResponsibilities: Label, description, validation, and focus presentation
Responsive grid collapse and field spacing

applicationResponsibilities: Form model, annotations, and cross-field rules

patterns.minimalRazorRecipe:
<EditForm Model="@Profile" OnValidSubmit="SaveAsync">
    <DataAnnotationsValidator />
    <FormSection Title="Profile">
        <FormValidationSummary />
        <FormGrid Columns="2">
            <FormField><AppTextBox Label="Name" @bind-Value="Profile.Name" /></FormField>
            <FormField><AppSelect Label="Team" Options="@Teams" @bind-Value="Profile.Team" /></FormField>
        </FormGrid>
        <FormActions><AppButton Type="submit" Variant="AppButtonVariant.Primary">Save</AppButton></FormActions>
    </FormSection>
</EditForm>

qualityChecks.requirement: Every field keeps a visible label, error association, and a logical keyboard order.
At the narrow breakpoint, the field grid becomes one readable column without changing source order.
Loading, server failure, and successful submission remain distinguishable without relying on color alone.

evidence.guarantee: Exercises section, grid, field, validation, and action composition.
Verifies the routed interactive and static form contracts.

@code {
    private Task<AppOverlayResult<Record>> EditAsync() =>
        OverlayService.ShowDrawerAsync<RecordEditor, Record>(
            new AppOverlayOptions { Title = "Record editor", DrawerPosition = AppDrawerPosition.End });

    private Task<AppOverlayResult<bool>> DeleteAsync() =>
        OverlayService.ShowConfirmationAsync(new AppConfirmationOptions
        {
            Title = "Delete this record?",
            Message = "This action cannot be undone.",
            Dangerous = true
        });
}
